## When to use it

Creates positioning, messaging, and brand architecture frameworks for multi-product companies. Use when the user wants to 'position a product suite,' 'multi-product positioning,' 'portfolio positioning,' 'brand architecture,' 'core narrative,' 'house of brands vs branded house,' 'product portfolio messaging,' 'launch a second product,' 'launch a new product into our suite,' 'audit our portfolio messaging,' or 'are our products fighting each other.' Sits above product-positioning and product-messaging in the hierarchy. Forces a brand architecture decision first, then builds the layered framework that single-product skills run inside of.

Example request:

> Use portfolio-positioning to improve this work using its complete upstream guidance.

Expected result: An output shaped by the complete upstream instructions, source material and the task at hand.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.10.0 --skill portfolio-positioning
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/portfolio-positioning/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/portfolio-positioning/references/GEEKIST-UPSTREAM.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
